title: Specifying min or max value for RangeInput refines automatically on this value
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior When using RangeInput, if setting a value for min or max, this value is automatically refined : ```tsx ``` ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce 1. Open the sandbox 2. See that current refinement includes price even if user did not refine any value ### Live reproduction https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/romantic-wilson-4ypmhs?file=%2Fsrc%2FApp.tsx%3A58%2C23 ### 💭 Expected behavior It should only change the allowed bounds, not refine on max value ### Package version algolia@4, react-instantsearch@7.15.4 ### Operating system *No response* ### Browser *No response* ### Code of Conduct * \[x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
